clue.text: Support heavyweight sea creatures

explanation.definitionFit: Plankton are the tiny drifting organisms living in oceans, a collective term for minute marine life.

clue.text: One does not start a fire

blocks.note: single means one

explanation.surface: A careful person who never lights a blaze.
explanation.walkthrough: SINGLE without its S leaves INGLE; the surface reads 'one' as a person who refuses to start fires.
explanation.definitionFit: An ingle is an old word for a hearth blaze, as in inglenook, the seat beside the household hearth.

clue.text: Petroleum producer offers inducements well

explanation.surface: An oil company sweetens a deal, and its well is mentioned too.
explanation.walkthrough: 'well' looks like an oil well in this surface, but it means healthy.
explanation.definitionFit: Oil shale is rock from which petroleum can be extracted by heating, so it yields crude.

clue.text: Leading serviceman in store had complete authority

blocks.note: its first letter
a depot is a storehouse

explanation.surface: A senior soldier in a supply depot ran the whole show.
explanation.definitionFit: A despot is a ruler with absolute power, someone who wields total control over others.

clue.text: Flavouring and cooking man's tripe

explanation.definitionFit: Spearmint is a herb whose oil gives taste to gum, toothpaste and sweets.

clue.text: Split up left-wing union

the National Union of Students

explanation.walkthrough: The NUS is Britain's National Union of Students. 'Split up' looks like one phrase but only 'Split' defines.
explanation.definitionFit: To sunder is to divide or tear apart, a literary verb for separating.

clue.text: Remove a rope in Gorky, say

explanation.surface: Taking a rope away somewhere in the Russian city of Gorky.
explanation.walkthrough: Gorky looks like the city or the writer Maxim Gorky; it is Arshile Gorky, the Armenian-American artist.
explanation.definitionFit: Arshile Gorky was a leading figure of abstract expressionism, so he is an example of this kind of artist.

clue.text: Climber accepts a period without a sweetheart

taken as written

explanation.definitionFit: A valentine is the person chosen as one's love on 14 February, hence a beloved.

explanation.walkthrough: 'Smoker' is no person but a chimney.

clue.text: Confound laid-back star working to capture record

clue.text: Polish plate and check for sign of approval

clue.text: It could have an accidental consequence

definitions.text: It could have an accidental consequence

blocks.clueFragment: It could have an accidental consequence

setter's reading: in music an accidental is a sharp, flat or natural sign that alters a pitch

explanation.walkthrough: An accidental is a music sign; the thing it affects is a single musical sound written on the stave.
explanation.definitionFit: A written musical pitch is what a sharp or flat sign alters, so it bears the consequence of an accidental.

clue.text: Famous craft worker in the old country

clue.text: Damage network with the removal of church composer

clue.text: Criticise a guerrilla for dashing style

taken as written
Che Guevara, the revolutionary

explanation.walkthrough: 'Hanging' suggests an execution, but it is an adjective meaning suspended.
explanation.definitionFit: Pendent is an adjective for something suspended or dangling, distinct from the noun pendant.

clue.text: Reformed pleb keeps papers of introduction

keeping means holding within, so the shuffled word surrounds the paper quantity

blocks.note: taken as written

explanation.definitionFit: A preamble is an opening statement before a document or speech, a prefatory section.

explanation.walkthrough: 'Pole' tempts as a nationality, but it is a magnetic pole. Eton is a famous English private school.
explanation.definitionFit: A native of Estonia, the Baltic state, is a European from a nation other than Poland.

clue.text: Solution to shyness frees communications in the main

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a party opener that relaxes strangers and a strengthened vessel cutting through frozen water.
